snippet.title: Gravity Was A Mistake – First Person Puzzle Platformer Trailer #platformer #games #indiegame
snippet.description:
Gravity Was A Mistake is a physics-based first-person puzzle platformer where gravity broke… and now everything pulls you upward. Your only goal: climb to the sky and escape.

Stack debris, drag floating objects, unlock wild skills (double jump, dash, glide) and see how far you can get.
Collect trash → recycle at Binny → gain XP → unlock new abilities.

It’s not just a game… it’s a challenge.
